parameters.query:
SELECT 
    r.sample_id,
    r.sample_project,
    r.lane,
    r.kit_ref,
    k.name AS library_prep_kit,
    i.i7_sequence as Index,
    i.i5_sequence as Index2
FROM reads r
LEFT JOIN indices i ON r.index_ref = i.uniqueref
LEFT JOIN kits k ON r.kit_ref = k.uniqueref
JOIN conversions c ON r.conversion_ref = c.uniqueref
JOIN runs run ON c.run_ref = run.uniqueref
WHERE run.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.run_id }}'
  AND c.status_concept_ref = 24
ORDER BY r.sample_id

SELECT 
    split_part(c.concept_name, '-', 1) as Read1Cycles,
    split_part(c.concept_name, '-', 4) as Read2Cycles,
    split_part(c.concept_name, '-', 2) as Index1Cycles,
    split_part(c.concept_name, '-', 3) as Index2Cycles
FROM runs r
JOIN concepts c ON r.reads_settings_concept_ref = c.uniqueref
WHERE r.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.run_id }}'

UPDATE conversions
SET status_concept_ref = 26
FROM runs run
WHERE conversions.run_ref = run.uniqueref
  AND run.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.run_id }}'
  AND conversions.status_concept_ref = 24
RETURNING conversions.uniqueref;

UPDATE conversions
SET status_concept_ref = 29,
    conversion_time = NOW(),
    tool_concept_ref = 108,
    storage_instrument_ref = 6
FROM runs run
WHERE conversions.run_ref = run.uniqueref
  AND run.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.run_id }}'
  AND conversions.status_concept_ref = 26;

SELECT
  r.uniqueref::int          AS uniqueref,
  r.run_id,
  r.instrument_ref::int     AS instrument_ref,
  r.flowcell_kit_ref::int   AS flowcell_kit_ref,
  r.flowcell_lot,
  r.date,
  r.reads_settings_concept_ref::int AS reads_settings_concept_ref,
  r.status_concept_ref::int AS status_concept_ref,
  r.storage_instrument_ref::int     AS storage_instrument_ref,
  r.updated_at,
  r.workflow_concept_ref::int       AS workflow_concept_ref,
  r.created_at,
  r.care_site_ref::int      AS care_site_ref,
  r.part,
  c.concept_name  AS workflow_type,
  ic.concept_name AS instrument_model
FROM runs r
LEFT JOIN concepts c    ON r.workflow_concept_ref = c.uniqueref
LEFT JOIN instruments i ON r.instrument_ref       = i.uniqueref
LEFT JOIN concepts ic   ON i.instrument_concept_ref = ic.uniqueref
WHERE r.run_id = '{{ $json.run_id }}';

SELECT c.uniqueref as conversion_ref,
       c.id_source_value,
       c.conversion_time,
       r.run_id
FROM conversions c
JOIN runs r ON c.run_ref = r.uniqueref
WHERE r.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.run_id }}';

parameters.query:
WITH
run_info AS (
  SELECT r.uniqueref AS run_ref, r.run_id, r.date AS run_date, r.flowcell_lot, r.part,
    cw.concept_name AS workflow_type,
    i.serial_number AS instrument_serial,
    ic.concept_name AS instrument_model,
    fk.name AS flowcell_kit,
    cs.care_site_name AS care_site_name
  FROM runs r
  LEFT JOIN concepts cw ON r.workflow_concept_ref = cw.uniqueref
  LEFT JOIN instruments i ON r.instrument_ref = i.uniqueref
  LEFT JOIN concepts ic ON i.instrument_concept_ref = ic.uniqueref
  LEFT JOIN kits fk ON r.flowcell_kit_ref = fk.uniqueref
  LEFT JOIN care_site cs ON r.care_site_ref = cs.uniqueref
  WHERE r.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.run_id }}'
),
conversion_info AS (
  SELECT c.uniqueref AS conversion_ref, c.id_source_value AS conversion_id_source,
    c.conversion_time, cs.concept_name AS conversion_status
  FROM conversions c
  JOIN run_info ri ON c.run_ref = ri.run_ref
  LEFT JOIN concepts cs ON c.status_concept_ref = cs.uniqueref
  ORDER BY c.uniqueref DESC LIMIT 1
),
sample_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rd.sample_id)::bigint AS sample_count,
    SUM(rd.reads)::bigint AS total_demux_reads
  FROM reads rd
  WHERE rd.conversion_ref = (SELECT conversion_ref FROM conversion_info)
),
lm AS (
  SELECT (substring(c.concept_name FROM 'L(\d+)'))::int AS lane,
    (substring(c.concept_name FROM ' R(\d)$'))::int AS read_num,
    regexp_replace(c.concept_name, ' L\d+ R\d$', '') AS metric_root,
    mr.value_as_number AS val
  FROM measurement_run mr
  JOIN concepts c ON mr.measurement_concept_ref = c.uniqueref
  WHERE mr.run_ref = (SELECT run_ref FROM run_info)
    AND c.concept_class_id = 'Lane Metric'
),
lane_summary AS (
  SELECT lane,
    SUM(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='Cluster Count' AND read_num=1) AS cluster_count,
    SUM(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='Cluster Count Pf' AND read_num=1) AS cluster_count_pf,
    AVG(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='% >= Q30') AS pct_q30,
    AVG(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='% Occupied') AS pct_occupied,
    AVG(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='% Aligned') AS pct_aligned,
    AVG(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='Error Rate') AS error_rate,
    SUM(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='Reads Pf') AS reads_pf,
    SUM(val) FILTER (WHERE metric_root='Yield G') AS yield_gb
  FROM lm GROUP BY lane
),
qc AS (
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(ls) ORDER BY ls.lane) AS lanes,
    SUM(cluster_count) AS total_cluster_count,
    SUM(cluster_count_pf) AS total_cluster_count_pf,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cluster_count)>0 THEN SUM(cluster_count_pf)/SUM(cluster_count)*100 END AS pct_pf,
    AVG(pct_q30) AS avg_pct_q30,
    AVG(pct_occupied) AS avg_pct_occupied,
    AVG(pct_aligned) AS avg_pct_aligned,
    AVG(error_rate) AS avg_error_rate,
    SUM(reads_pf) AS total_reads_pf,
    SUM(yield_gb) AS total_yield_gb
  FROM lane_summary ls
)
SELECT ri.*, ci.*, ss.*, qc.*
FROM run_info ri
LEFT JOIN conversion_info ci ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN sample_stats ss ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN qc ON TRUE;

UPDATE conversions
SET status_concept_ref = 24,
    conversion_time = NOW()
FROM runs run
WHERE conversions.run_ref = run.uniqueref
  AND run.run_id = '{{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.run_id }}'
  AND conversions.status_concept_ref = 26;
